- No information is provided for Weeks 1–3, so it is impossible to describe how weekly exercise frequency changed over the past month.

- The only heart event record is from a single day (Mar 30), showing 2 premature heartbeat events that were not classified specifically as premature ventricular contractions (PVCs).
- With no weekly data and no PVC-specific identification, trends in weekly PVC events over the past month cannot be determined.
